candidates.detail: Public BodySurface holds positions and faces, and public GroomedHair::place passes it to BodyField::sample. NearMesh filters faces by the expanded hair bounds and casts the retained face count to u32 without a 20-bit capacity guard. The seed shader packs the filtered ordinal t into the low 20 bits beneath proximity; flood start masks exactly those 20 bits and adds one, reserving zero for no triangle. At t = 2^20, a nonzero winning seed has decoded ordinal zero rather than 2^20, and the ordinal high bit overlaps proximity. A field with at most 2^20 retained faces has ordinal values 0 through 2^20-1; one more face can produce an unrepresentable ordinal. This is source and integer-layout reasoning only, with no GPU or product execution.
candidates.consumer_and_safeguards: The actual place path passes the prepared field to carry and shrinkwrap operations; the studio BodyHead builds BodySurface from generated positions and model mesh faces. No selected admission limit was found in these paths. The capacity risk is conditional on more than 2^20 faces surviving filtering, an overflowing face producing a seed that wins the atomic comparison, and device submission succeeding. The selected ordinary model face count, valid oversized body availability, GPU limits, resulting field and user impact were not established. Vertex normals are computed before filtering and require valid face indices; this trace does not certify topology or numeric bounds.
